snippet.title: Continuum (Dos game 1990)
snippet.description:
Continuum  is a primitive polygon 3D game.
I don't know about this game's rule exactly.
It's very esoteric, I think.

For reference, "Alpha Waves" similar with this game exists.
In addition, This game was also released in Amiga and Atari ST.
